I have attached in the ticket some pictures showing the issue. In high current charging sessions, one DC pin in the plug is getting much hotter than the other. When the temperature difference is higher that 25ºC, the session is aborted. We have many interruptions in this charger due to this problem. There are 2 reasons for this to happen, first is dust inside the plug. Please check if the DC pins have dirt inside and clean it. Second option is that one of DC pins is already damage/broken and in this case is necessary to replace the cable.
